lighting.notes: Evaluated on representative subsets from the test split. Bright daylight images dominate the training data, so performance degrades in low-light and night-time scenes.

weather.notes: Rain and fog reduce visibility and introduce artifacts (droplets, glare) that lower both precision and recall. The training set has very few foggy examples.

crowd_density.notes: Higher crowd density increases occlusion, causing more missed detections (lower recall) and occasional duplicate or misclassified boxes (lower precision).
